name: Hanimi Shiina
source: This girl combines an elegant lady from the high society and mischievous succubus which can cling to you with her claws from the side where you don't expect it. Shiina knows a lot about tea, and she can be seen with a cup of this drink pretty often. As a rich woman, Shiina, just like her brother, prefers to move to the destination by helicopter.
